subject: Order form addendum — lightweight audit lanes, pen-test notice & evidence cadence
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Barnes <eliot.barnes@bluebridgelabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Order form addendum — lightweight audit lanes, pen-test notice & evidence cadence

Hi Eliot —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Attached is a first-pass evidence inventory and a short proposal for how we can make the security exhibit (Order Form Addendum A) less disruptive for Bluebridge while preserving your right to reasonable inspections. High level: introduce two audit lanes ("lightweight" + "full") with clear gating + a pen-test notice window. Key points: 

- Lightweight lane: monthly request window, limited artifacts (artifact matrix attached), no live forensic access, staging-only.
- Full lane: annual SOC 2 + bounded inspection windows for deeper evidence (by exception).
- Pen-test: rolling windows with notice; we propose 30-day notice and a 45-day remediation SLA for critical findings.
- PII & redaction: Redwood will provide redacted artifacts by default; raw logs only under scoped legal request.

Attachments: S-Evidence-Inventory.xlsx (spreadsheet, artifact matrix), pen-test-scope-draft.pdf (scope draft).

Action items / ask of Bluebridge: please confirm whether the staging-only constraint is acceptable and whether you'd prefer a shorter notice window for pen-tests (we listed 30 days here) — if you can get back to us by EOD Aug 5 that keeps our order form timeline on track.

If that sounds reasonable I’ll circulate a redline with concrete clause language for the Order Form addendum and the evidence-rate table we discussed.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form addendum — lightweight audit lanes, pen-test notice & evidence cadence

Ava —

Appreciate the summary and the artifact matrix. A few quick clarifying questions from Bluebridge InfoSec: 

1) Pen-test notice: we generally ask for 14 days notice for external tests to coordinate internal resources. Is 14 days something Redwood can accept for at least one round per year?
2) "Lightweight" artifacts: can you spell out exactly what will be produced? our compliance team needs a checklist (configs, control screenshots, limited logs).
3) Staging-only: we support staging-scoped access; please confirm that production access is explicitly excluded unless mutually agreed in writing.
4) SOC 2 cadence: do you have an expected delivery date for the next SOC 2 report? we need that for our risk review.

If you can update the addendum to include an artifact checklist and an explicit staging-only clause, we can review it with legal and come back quickly. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call if that helps.

Thanks,
Eliot Barnes
Head of InfoSec, Bluebridge Labs
eliot.barnes@bluebridgelabs.com | +1 206-555-3310

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form addendum — lightweight audit lanes, pen-test notice & evidence cadence

Folks —

Draft reply for Eliot and Bluebridge below. I’ve also attached a redline we can send after we agree internally. Key compromises we should offer:

- Pen-test notice compromise: 21 days (middle ground between 14 and 30). We can reserve an exception to accept 14 days for one agreed annual test if Bluebridge pushes for it, but require mutual confirmation in advance.
- Lightweight artifact checklist: include minimal set (control screenshots, config exports, summarized application logs for a 72-hour window, role-based access list). No PII-containing raw logs; Redwood will redact.
- Staging-only: explicitly stated. Production access only upon mutual written consent for a scoped time-boxed inspection.
- SOC 2 cadence: we will provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report (expected delivery Q4 2027); in the interim, provide the SOC 2 attestation letter and our security summary.
- Evidence-rate / gates: define categories (critical / standard / low) with monthly/quarterly/annual sampling frequencies in the attached table.

Legal redlines to include in the addendum: remediation SLA 45 days for critical items, summary-level pen-test report only (detailed exploit steps redacted), and a carveout that we won’t provide customer PII extracts. Karthik — please review the attached orderform-addendum-redline.docx and advise any legal language tweaks.

If OK I’ll send this to Eliot and mark the doc as "commented" in Drive so Bluebridge can suggest edits.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Security Programs, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Date: 2027-08-02T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form addendum — lightweight audit lanes, pen-test notice & evidence cadence

Eliot —

Thanks for the fast review. Per internal discussion (cc’d Laura / Marissa / Karthik) we can propose the following compromise:

- Pen-test notice: 21 days standard; allow one 14-day window per 12-month period by mutual agreement.
- Lightweight artifacts: we’ll deliver the checklist items (control screenshots, config export, RBAC list, summarized 72-hour logs) — attached inventory and Drive link included. Raw production logs with PII are excluded; redacted extracts only.
- Scope: strictly staging environment; production access requires separate written approval.
- SOC 2: latest Type II attestation expected Q4 2027; interim attestation letter provided on request.
- Remediation: 45-day SLA for critical items; summary-level pen-test reporting only.

Next steps:
1) Bluebridge to confirm lane classification and whether you accept the 21-day default by EOD Aug 5.
2) Redwood will finalize the Order Form addendum and circulate a signature-ready doc by Aug 12 (orderform-addendum-redline.docx).
3) I’ll set up a 30-minute walkthrough for the artifact matrix week of Aug 8 — propose Aug 9 at 10am PT, but we can adjust.

Drive link (artifact matrix & redline): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example-evidence
Jira for tracking legal redline: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-128

If that aligns with Bluebridge priorities we’ll move the addendum into the order form for signature.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
